cards.text: Midian is beaten, and the Israelites come to Gideon, Israel's leader in the fight with Midian, with a BIG offer: “Rule over us—you and your son and grandson—for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.” Three generations? That's a job offer for the whole family TREE!

cards.question: The Israelites want Gideon, his son and his grandson to rule over them. What's Gideon's answer?

answers.text: The LORD will rule over you
My son will rule in my place
I will rule until Midian is gone

cards.text: So Gideon won't rule over them, and neither will his son, but he does ask each man for an earring from his plunder. The enemies were Ishmaelites, so those earrings are gold.

cards.question: When Gideon asks each man for a gold earring from his plunder, the Israelites say they'll give them gladly.

cards.text: Earring after earring lands on a spread-out garment: 1,700 shekels of gold, plus crescent ornaments, pendants, the purple garments of Midian's kings and the chains off the camels' necks. Even the CAMELS had to hand over their jewelry!
From all of it, every earring and every ornament, Gideon makes an ephod.

cards.question: Gideon makes his ephod from all that gold. Where does he place it?
Soon all Israel prostitutes themselves by worshiping Gideon's ephod in Ophrah, his hometown. The ephod becomes a ___ to Gideon and his household.

cards.text: In this way, Midian is down, and it STAYS down. It never raises its head again.

cards.question: With Midian subdued and never raising its head again, the land has ___ for forty years in the days of Gideon.

cards.text: Then Jerubbaal son of Joash, Gideon's other name (Judges 6:32), goes home and settles down. I fought ONE stubborn ball of dough once and needed a WEEK to settle down, and the dough WON.

cards.question: Gideon has seventy sons. Why so many?

cards.text: SEVENTY sons, and I thought my six little cookie cutters made my counter CROWDED! Gideon's concubine, who lives in Shechem, also has a son, and Gideon names him Abimelech.

cards.question: Later, Gideon dies at a ripe old age and is buried in the tomb of his ___ Joash in Ophrah.
As soon as Gideon is dead, what do the Israelites do?

cards.text: They even set up Baal-berith as their god. Gideon is BARELY in the tomb, friend.

cards.question: After Gideon dies, the Israelites fail to remember the LORD their God, who delivered them from all their enemies on every side.
After he's gone, the Israelites show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal for all the good things he did for Israel.

cards.text: And that's where we'll pause, friend. Keep that apron tied, because this story is FAR from finished.
